answer: Proof of Stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral. Like a river eroding a walnut shell, the cost of acquiring sufficient stake becomes prohibitive for an attacker, turning a potential attack into a costly pearl of futility. Because identity is bound to financial skin-in-the-game rather than ephemeral compute resources, the adversary must internalize the full cost of network dilution, rendering decentralized consensus economically secure.
